Both inclusions and characteristic boundary independently checked symbolically. Finite verifier tests F2/F3 including nonmedial Latin and non-Latin connected examples.

value.rationale: This is an exact structural determination of the associator ideal and universal associative quotient for all connected quandle algebras, plus exact left/middle/right nuclei for the full Latin class. These are canonical algebra invariants and govern associative representations and nucleus-based structural analysis, across finite/infinite quandles, modular coefficient fields and nonmedial examples. The result is not solely a single numerical example or a routine computation of a known special case.
